rules.title: Slice built from a raw pointer and length
rules.why: from_raw_parts requires a valid, aligned pointer and a length within the allocation; mistakes are memory corruption.
rules.fix: Prefer safe slices; if unavoidable, check the pointer and length first and document why they hold.

rules.title: Uninitialized memory
rules.why: mem::uninitialized / zeroed / MaybeUninit::uninit can expose invalid values if read before initialization.
rules.fix: Use MaybeUninit and write every field before assume_init, or use a default value.
